description: Lists the directory tree below the project root (or a subdirectory) as compact lines: `d path` for a directory, `f path bytes` for a file, `l path` for a symlink (never followed), `o path` for a special file. The last line, starting with `#`, is metadata (entries_listed, stop_reason, counters). Use it first to learn the layout before reading files. depth 1 to 3 (default 2), max_entries 1 to 200 (default 100). Hidden entries are skipped unless include_hidden is true. The directories .git, target, node_modules, .venv, and __pycache__ are listed but not entered. Read-only.

depth.description: How many directory levels to list.

include_hidden.description: List entries whose name starts with `.`.

path.description: Root-relative directory path with `/` separators; empty or omitted means the root. No leading `/`, no `.` or `..` components.

name: workspace_outline
title: Workspace outline

description: Returns lines of one text file below the project root as `<line>\t<text>`, starting at start_line (default 1), at most max_lines lines (1 to 400, default 120) and max_bytes bytes of text (256 to 12288, default 8192). Lines over 400 characters are cut with a ` [+N chars]` suffix. A binary file returns a one-line marker. The last line, starting with `#`, is metadata (returned_lines, end_line, at_eof, total_lines, stop_reason). Use it instead of printing whole files; call again with a later start_line for more. Read-only.

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of returned line text.

path.description: Root-relative file path with `/` separators. No leading `/`, no `.` or `..` components.

name: file_slice
title: File slice

description: Searches text files below the project root (or a subdirectory or one file) for a literal string, 1 to 128 characters, not a regular expression. Output is grep-style: a `== path` header per file, `<line>:<text>` for matches, `<line>-<text>` for context lines (context_lines 0 to 2), `--` between separated groups, and a final `#` metadata line (matches, files_scanned, stop_reason). Case-insensitive by default (ASCII folding). Skips hidden entries unless include_hidden, binary files, files over 1 MiB, symlinks, and the directories .git, target, node_modules, .venv, __pycache__. Returns at most max_matches matches (1 to 100, default 40). Read-only.

path.description: Root-relative directory or file path; empty or omitted means the root.

query.description: Literal text to find; not a regular expression; no control characters.

name: text_search
title: Text search
